Event Types

Built for events with production weight.

Wild Ones does not position itself as a general social-events venue. The target market is organizers running substantial programming, technical production or multi-zone guest experiences.

LIVE 01

Concerts + Live Shows

Artist-led events, touring concepts, showcase nights and live entertainment requiring a defined stage, FOH, backstage and audience plan.

  • Stage + audience orientation
  • Audio / lighting / video footprint
  • Artist + crew circulation
  • Ticketing + security
NIGHT 02

EDM + Dance Events

DJ-driven events and nightlife concepts where sound, lighting, immersive visuals, bar flow and late-night operations matter.

  • DJ / stage production
  • FOH + lighting control
  • Bars + water service
  • Guest flow + security
SCALE 03

Festivals + Multi-Act Programs

Extended-format events with multiple performers, vendors, activations and a more complex operating schedule.

  • Artist turnover
  • Vendor / merch villages
  • Backstage scheduling
  • Load-in + load-out phasing
RESET 04

Retreats + Immersive Gatherings

Private programs combining workshops, wellness, instruction, music, meals and extended property use.

  • Program zones
  • Meal + beverage service
  • Quiet / active separation
  • Multi-day logistics
BUILD 05

Production Company Rentals

Venue rental for professional producers who want to bring their own technical, creative and operational vendors.

  • Client-led production plan
  • Venue feasibility review
  • Vendor compliance
  • Custom site layout
BRAND 06

Activations + Private Productions

Brand launches, content-driven events, private hospitality and invitation-only experiences with custom build requirements.

  • Branded environments
  • VIP zones
  • Media / content areas
  • Controlled guest access
